title.id: Rilis v1.0.4 — Redesain Total UI Khas Termius Desktop & Sanitasi Keamanan Data
title.en: Release v1.0.4 — Complete Termius Desktop UI Redesign & Data Security Sanitization

body.id: Pembaruan v1.0.4 menghadirkan perombakan antarmuka visual secara menyeluruh terinspirasi dari Termius Desktop SSH client. Dilengkapi tema midnight dark navy premium, bilah header dengan omni-search bar dan dynamic terminal tabs, sidebar navigasi dengan ikon presisi, serta panel inspector detail host dengan auto-save debounced otomatis.
body.en: Update v1.0.4 introduces a complete visual UI overhaul inspired by Termius Desktop SSH client. Features include a premium midnight dark navy theme, top header with omni-search and dynamic terminal tabs, precise left navigation sidebar icons, and a real-time host details inspector with debounced auto-save.

items.id: Desain Antarmuka Termius Desktop: Tata letak baru bergaya Termius dengan palet midnight dark navy (#0a0d18, #0e1220, #161c30) dan aksen glowing outline.
items.en: Termius Desktop UI Design: New Termius-styled layout with midnight dark navy palette (#0a0d18, #0e1220, #161c30) and glowing outline accents.

items.id: Bilah Header Terintegrasi: Dilengkapi menu toggle sidebar (≡), pemilih Vaults cloud, tab dinamis sesi terminal aktif & SFTP, serta Omni-Search bar dengan tombol Connect instan.
items.en: Integrated Top Header: Equipped with sidebar menu toggle (≡), Vaults cloud profile switcher, dynamic active terminal & SFTP tabs, and Omni-Search bar with instant Connect button.

items.id: Sidebar Navigasi Presisi: Ikon vektor baru untuk Hosts, Keychain, Port Forwarding, Snippets { }, Known Hosts, Logs, dan Settings.
items.en: Precise Navigation Sidebar: New vector icons for Hosts, Keychain, Port Forwarding, Snippets { }, Known Hosts, Logs, and Settings.

items.id: Panel Inspektur Host Details: Pengeditan live langsung di sisi kanan dengan auto-save debounced 400ms ke backend tanpa tombol simpan manual.
items.en: Host Details Inspector Panel: Live side editing with 400ms debounced auto-save to backend without manual save buttons.

items.id: Distro OS Vector Badges: Tampilan logo OS asli (Ubuntu, Debian, Windows, Linux) pada setiap kartu host di grid.
items.en: Distro OS Vector Badges: Authentic vector OS badges (Ubuntu, Debian, Windows, Linux) on every host card in the grid.

items.id: Sanitasi Data Rahasia: Menghapus seluruh host, domain, dan kredensial privat dari berkas seed data bawaan sebelum rilis publik.
items.en: Secret Data Sanitization: Purged all private hosts, domains, and credentials from default seed data files prior to public release.
